services.desc: While we hope that you never need to cancel your camping reservations, please read the following: Cancellation policies are based on when a reservation is cancelled in relation to your arrival date, regardless of when the original reservation was made. Any reservation canceled at least 30 days prior to arrival date will result in a refund in the form in which you paid, minus a $20 per site cancellation fee. Any reservation canceled less than 30 days but at least 7 days (1 week) prior to reservation arrival date will be entitled to a Sunfox Campground Camper’s Credit for a future stay, minus a $20 per site cancellation fee. Any cancellation made less than 7 days prior to reservation arrival

blurb: Sunfox Campground is located in Lisbon, Connecticut, just miles from Mystic, Foxwoods and Mohegan Sun. Sunfox is a family campground in eastern CT, offering seasonal sites, special event weekends, scheduled activities, a heated swimming pool & hot tub, Bingo and a pond for swimming and fishing.
